summary: Tested Motore Sfide (backend + frontend), mandatory registration gate on Social, Sapori di Casa and Calcolatore Metodo. Backend: 10/10 pytest passed (catalog=8 with 4 honor/4 internal, state defaults total=8/need_panettoni=3/need_all=6, honor complete + idempotency, internal unmet -> 400, unknown id -> 400, threshold 3 -> academy+unlock_panettoni (pro=false), threshold 6 -> pro+unlock_all, /api/content/access). Frontend (mobile 390x844): guest Sfide overlay shows title/progress/8 items/sfide-register; guest Social shows community-auth-gate + community-register-btn with no feed; logged-in (amico2) shows community-feed and no gate; honor challenge whatsapp_share completes with success toast and progress 0/8 -> 1/8, item marked done; internal challenge shows error toast; paywall-challenge in Your Lab PaywallGate opens the Sfide overlay; Sapori di Casa 4 tabs all render content and sapori-back returns Home; Calcolatore Metodo recalculates all calc-row-* + calc-water-temp + calc-mix-min on input/select change and calc-back returns Home. No critical issues found.

integration_issues.flow: Sfide - internal challenge not yet met
integration_issues.issue: Error toast shows the backend Italian detail string ('Sfida non ancora completata: completala nella community e riprova.') even when UI language is EN/DE/ES. Sfide.jsx prefers e.response.data.detail over the localized fallback.

action_items: (minor i18n) Localize the internal-challenge failure toast instead of showing the raw Italian backend detail, or return a language-aware detail from /api/challenges/complete.
(minor) Duplicate data-testid 'calc-flour': AcademyHome.jsx (select) and CalcolatoreMetodo.jsx (input). Rename one (e.g. 'calcmetodo-flour') to avoid ambiguous selectors in tests.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is ~6850 lines — well over the 700-line guideline; consider splitting challenges/entitlements into routers/modules.

_apply_challenge_unlocks overwrites entitlements with source='challenges' via upsert $set; a paying user (source='stripe') who completes 6 challenges would have source/plan_tier overwritten. Consider preserving paid source metadata.
